about: Made by tools/build_garments.py: sewn from flat pattern pieces and draped on Dave (CHAR_DEF, after propWarp) in headless Blender. pos: welded points (float32 x, y, z, his warped frame; the page scales the figure by 1/scale afterwards). Pattern points: vmap (their welded point), piece, pat (their place on the flat pattern in metres: x round, y up from the hem), idx (triangles over them, uint16). bind: each welded point's body triangle (data/body.json idx) and b, c, h: X = (1-b-c) A + b B + c C + h n, n the unit normal cross(B-A, C-A). hood.pins: hood point, garment point it is sewn to.
